units.source_text: 源氏晓起夜眠，泪无干时，两眼模糊，昏沉度日。

en.t: Genji rose at dawn and slept only at night; his tears never dried, his eyes grew blurred, and he passed his days in a daze.

units.source_text: 他从头细想一生行事：“我对镜顾影，自知相貌不凡，此外一切，无不远胜常人。

en.t: He thought carefully back over the whole course of his life: “When I look at myself in the mirror, I know my appearance is exceptional, and in every other respect as well I have far surpassed ordinary people.

units.source_text: 而自髫年以来，屡遭人生无常之痛，常思佛法指引，度我出家。

en.t: Yet since childhood I have repeatedly suffered the pain of life’s impermanence, and I have often wished for the Buddha’s teaching to guide me and lead me into religious life.

units.source_text: 只因难下决心，终于因循度日，遂致身受过去未来无有其例的苦患。

en.t: Only because I could not make up my mind, I kept putting it off day after day, and so I have come to bear a suffering without equal in past or future.

units.source_text: 如今以后，对此世间已无可留恋。

en.t: From now on, there is nothing left in this world for me to cling to.

units.source_text: 从此专心修行，应无一切障碍。

en.t: If I devote myself entirely to religious practice from this point onward, there should be no obstacle at all.

units.source_text: 岂知心中如此悲伤恼乱，深恐难入菩提之道。”

en.t: But who could have known that my heart would be so grief-stricken and disturbed? I deeply fear that I may not be able to enter the path to enlightenment.”

units.source_text: 他心中不安，便向佛祈祷：“但愿佛力加庇，勿使我心过分悲恸！”

en.t: Uneasy at heart, he prayed to the Buddha: “May the Buddha’s power protect me, and not let my heart grieve beyond measure!”

units.source_text: 各方都来吊慰，自皇上以下，无不异常诚恳周至，殊非一般世间应酬可比。

en.t: People came from every quarter to offer condolences and comfort; from the emperor on down, all were exceptionally sincere and considerate, quite unlike ordinary social formalities.

units.source_text: 但源氏心事重重，对此人世虚荣，如同不闻不见，全不加以注意。

en.t: But Genji was weighed down by many thoughts, and toward the vain honors of this world he acted as though he neither heard nor saw them, paying them no attention at all.

units.source_text: 然而又不肯叫人看出痴迷之状。

en.t: Even so, he would not let others see the extent of his dazed obsession.

units.source_text: 深恐后人讥评，说他到此晚年，还要为了丧失爱妻而心灰意懒，遁入空门。

en.t: He greatly feared that later generations would mock him, saying that even in his old age he had lost heart over the death of his beloved wife and fled into the priesthood.

units.source_text: 为了身不由主，更添一番痛苦。

en.t: Because he could not act freely as he wished, this added yet another layer of pain.
